title: Proper marked scheme deformation class functor and hull
statement: For a field $k$ [def-weil-field], a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, use the marked flat lift category of [def-sfb-marked-scheme-lifts]. The test category and complete local coefficient algebra, with its residue-preserving local maps, are those of [def-sfb-artin-deformation-test-category]. A proper marked deformation over a test algebra $R$ is a marked flat lift with proper structure projection [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-weil-flat-morphism]. Its class set is the quotient by marked isomorphisms. Base change is the cartesian marked relation using the scheme fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]. A class functor is the functor on these actual class sets whose map takes every representative to its cartesian base change; base changes must exist. For such a functor $F$, a hull consists of a complete Noetherian local $k$-algebra $B$ with specified residue $k$ and maps $\eta_R:\operatorname{Hom}_{k,\mathrm{loc}}(B,R)\to F(R)$, natural under composition, with the lifting property for every surjective test-algebra arrow and bijective $\eta_{k[\epsilon]/\epsilon^2}$. Local maps are automatically continuous for the maximal-ideal-adic topologies.
